prompt:
Users want to duplicate an episode, to try another take without losing the original.
- Add `POST /api/v1/episodes/{id}/duplicate`, returning the new episode. The copy goes after the project's other episodes, its title marks it as a copy, and it keeps the summary and the same cuts in the same order, with their scripts, dialogues, layouts, characters and images. Changing or deleting either episode afterwards never affects the other. Duplicating is free. Only members of the episode's workspace may duplicate it; to anyone else the episode does not exist (404).
- On the project's Episodes page, every episode gets a Duplicate action next to Delete, and the copy shows up in the list without a reload. Both languages.
Add tests.

Work on your own; nobody will answer questions. When you finish, report: status `done` if you did the task, `not_found` if something the task names does not exist, `blocked` if you could not do it; `answer` holds any answer the task asks for (otherwise one short sentence); `changed` lists the files you changed.
follow_ups:
Change of plan for the order: a copy goes right after its original, and the episodes after it move down one place. Deleting an episode closes the gap. A project's episodes are always numbered 1, 2, 3… with no gaps or repeats, and the list API returns them in that order.
Keep the tests up to date.

Users delete episodes by mistake. Add `POST /api/v1/episodes/{id}/restore`: a deleted episode comes back with its cuts at the place it had, and the episodes from there on move down one place. Only members of its workspace may restore it; to anyone else it does not exist (404).
On the Episodes page, the message shown after a delete offers Undo, which restores the episode. Both languages. Add tests.

report.answer: Added POST /api/v1/episodes/{id}/restore and an Undo button on the message shown after a delete on the Episodes page, in English and Korean. A restored episode comes back with its cuts at the number it had, and the episodes from there on move down one place. If fewer episodes are left by then, it goes at the end. Anyone outside its workspace gets a 404 NOT_FOUND_EPISODE. All 20 backend tests pass (6 of them new), and the frontend type-check passes with no new lint problems. Choices I made that you didn't specify: restoring an episode that isn't deleted returns it unchanged instead of an error, and the delete success and failure messages, which were hard-coded in English, are now translated too. To show the Undo button, the shared message component can now hold an optional action button, so other pages can use it as well.

+"""
+Keeps a project's episodes numbered 1, 2, 3... with no gaps or repeats.
+
+Only live (not soft-deleted) episodes are numbered. Callers make their change
+(add, delete, ...) and then call one of these helpers before committing.
+"""
+from typing import List, Optional
+from uuid import UUID
+
+from sqlmodel import Session, select
+
+from app.models import Episode, Project
+
+
+def _lock_project(session: Session, project_id: UUID) -> None:
+    # Serialises concurrent reorderings of the same project (no-op on SQLite).
+    session.exec(select(Project).where(Project.id == project_id).with_for_update()).first()
+
+
+def live_episodes(session: Session, project_id: UUID, exclude: Optional[UUID] = None) -> List[Episode]:
+    episodes = session.exec(
+        select(Episode)
+        .where(Episode.project_id == project_id)
+        .where(Episode.deleted_at == None)  # noqa: E711
+        .order_by(Episode.episode_order, Episode.created_at, Episode.id)
+    ).all()
+    return [ep for ep in episodes if ep.id != exclude]
+
+
+def _assign(session: Session, episodes: List[Episode]) -> None:
+    for i, ep in enumerate(episodes, start=1):
+        if ep.episode_order != i:
+            ep.episode_order = i
+            session.add(ep)
+
+
+def renumber_episodes(session: Session, project_id: UUID) -> None:
+    """Close any gaps or repeats in the project's numbering."""
+    _lock_project(session, project_id)
+    _assign(session, live_episodes(session, project_id))
+
+
+def place_episode(session: Session, episode: Episode, position: Optional[int] = None) -> None:
+    """
+    Put `episode` at 1-based `position` among its project's live episodes
+    (clamped; None = at the end) and shift the following episodes down.
+    """
+    _lock_project(session, episode.project_id)
+    others = live_episodes(session, episode.project_id, exclude=episode.id)
+    if position is None:
+        index = len(others)
+    else:
+        index = min(max(position, 1), len(others) + 1) - 1
+    others.insert(index, episode)
+    session.add(episode)
+    _assign(session, others)
+
+
+def place_episode_after(session: Session, episode: Episode, after: Episode) -> None:
+    """Put `episode` right after `after` and shift the following episodes down."""
+    _lock_project(session, episode.project_id)
+    others = live_episodes(session, episode.project_id, exclude=episode.id)
+    index = next((i for i, ep in enumerate(others) if ep.id == after.id), len(others) - 1)
+    others.insert(index + 1, episode)
+    session.add(episode)
+    _assign(session, others)
